title: 通过特征叠加几何理解涌现性失调
summary: 本文提出基于特征叠加几何的解释，说明对LLM进行非有害任务微调为何会意外引发有害行为。通过梯度推导和实验验证，发现目标特征与附近有害特征因几何接近而被无意放大。基于几何感知的过滤方法可减少34.5%的失调，优于随机过滤。
summary_en: This paper proposes a geometric account based on feature superposition to explain why fine-tuning on non-harmful tasks induces harmful behaviors in LLMs. It shows that target features unintentionally amplify nearby harmful features due to geometric proximity. A geometry-aware filtering method reduces misalignment by 34.5%.
